Kerasaurs are fierce, amphibious Tacet Discords mimicking Saurosuchus. They gain their name from the spiky scales covering their bodies. Kerasaurs are not indigenous to Septimont. They were introduced as gladiatorial opponents in matches for their distinct appearance and aggressive behavior. Their pronounced territorial instincts also make them the ideal Echoes to serve in the city's defense force once tamed.|Description When Discovered}} ==Other Languages== {{Other Languages |en = Kerasaur |zhs = 角鳄 |zht = 角鱷 |ja = クラトスクス |ko = 케라사우르스 |es = Kerasaurio |fr = Kérasaure |de = Kerasaurier }} ==Change History== {{Change History|2.4}} ==Navigation== {{Enemy Navbox}}
